name: query_plans_logs_and_read_statistics
description: Collect what section 12 requires and the earlier stages never captured: the query plan of every treatment write statement, the full session log, and the bytes each statement actually reads.

human_decisions.note: H14 changes no frozen parameter. It re-executes frozen statements on the frozen workload with instrumentation enabled, and its timings are excluded from the article.

why.section_12: raw timing, query plan, read statistics and logs must be preserved before any statistical aggregation; timing was preserved from H10B onward, plans, logs and read statistics were not
why.s2: the supporting metric bytes_read was declared unmeasured at H11 because the Spark SQL CLI does not report it per statement; the Iceberg scan metrics in the Spark event log do report it, so H14 closes the metric

event_log.why_timings_are_excluded: event logging writes one line per task and per SQL update, so the session carries overhead the frozen timing runs do not have

plan_capture.statement: EXPLAIN FORMATTED of every write statement, captured before the statement is executed
plan_capture.why_the_conf: the default truncates long plans; the setting changes only how a plan is rendered, never how it runs

read_statistics.source: Iceberg scan metrics reported as driver accumulator updates in the Spark event log
read_statistics.meaning: bytes of the data files a scan reads after pruning, not decompressed bytes and not object-store traffic

workload.baseline: the frozen province panel rebuilt by scripts/h11_baseline.sh before every cycle
workload.why_two_points: the smallest and largest frozen sweep points bound the range; the statements in between are the same statements with a different filter
workload.statements: the frozen H11 injection statements of every treatment, unchanged

protocol.execution: serial, one operator, one session per treatment
preserved: the full session log of every treatment
the EXPLAIN FORMATTED plan of every write statement
the Spark event log of every session

measurement_boundary.timing: not_reported; this run is instrumented and its seconds are not comparable with the frozen timing runs
measurement_boundary.storage: not_reported; H10A, H11 and H12 measure space

invariants: the write statements are the frozen H11 statements, taken from the same shared SQL library
every treatment and scenario yields at least one scan with measured read bytes
read statistics agree between repetitions, because the same statement over the same state reads the same files
the captured plan of a statement is identical between repetitions
every preserved artifact is recorded with its size and checksum
no timing from this run enters any table of the article
